## Backend API Test — Run 53 (2026-07-21) — CONVERGED

**No code fixes needed. Nothing is broken.** Backend is byte-identical to a 12-run-converged baseline, and I confirmed it with live evidence rather than trusting stale memory.

**Hard precondition (proven):** `git diff --stat 2d7fb57..HEAD -- server/` is **empty** — every commit since the last audit (2026-06-19) is an automated `checkpoint: pre-overnight-run` (+ one `docs:` QA report). 37 route files / 245 routes, unchanged.

**Live smoke suite** (server up on :3001, token minted via HTTP login):

| Probe | Result |
|---|---|
| sweep-all (245 routes) | `200×91 / 400×72 / 403×6 / 404×75 / 503×1` — 0 unintentional 5xx |
| type-fuzz (1026 payloads) | 0 5xx / 0 err |
| tenant-isolation | 22 / 22 (spoofed `tenant_id` + `X-Tenant-Id` ignored; non-admin → 403) |
| happy-write | 3 / 3 (PATCH lead + invoice → 200) |

The lone 503 is the **intentional** skip-trace stub (no `TRACERFY_API_KEY`, per the zero-paid-API charter). All non-200s are correct-by-design (validation 400s, admin-only 403s, missing-id 404s). No endpoint returns an unintentional 500/crash — error handling is graceful throughout.

**Outcome: Backend CONVERGED — 13th consecutive 0-fix run.** No changes made (charter forbids touching working code). Deliverable written to `C:\tmp\api-test-results.txt`; resume + MEMORY index updated.

**Next run:** don't re-test the backend — only re-test if the developer adds new route/page/component files. Remaining gaps are all frontend and out-of-charter (Esc-to-close = enhancement; EstimateBuilder @375px = mobile, which is paused).
